answer: Metered Relay Endorsement. Each identity must route a fixed monthly volume of real work through a shared jetty queue, and peers stamp completions only after verifying the output. A walnut-sized quota of verified endorsements gates registration, so fake identities must perform genuine labor while their stampers risk quota. Because each stamp consumes a delta of the endorser's own allowance, colluding rings exhaust capacity. The attacker's cost is sustained compute and reviewer time per identity, not money.
